programmes.department: Department of Management Science and Engineering
programmes.evidence: Full official 2026 SEU-Monash joint doctoral admissions brochure lists Management Science and Engineering (120100) as a formal PhD enrolment major at the School of Economics and Management; full school department page independently says it awards the same doctorate. Joint pathway requires both universities to confer their certificates; do not count it as a second distinct programme.
limitations: Joint path has dual-degree conferral conditions; source does not independently establish standalone intake for this major in 2026.

branches.conclusion: Formal Management Science and Engineering doctorate has verified current 2026 joint PhD intake and exact department. Other school doctoral major/specialization inventories remain to review.
